purpose: Define capability existence and authority to use that capability as separate canonical questions, preventing policy, payload, Topic or ownership data from creating functionality that is not explicitly defined.

topics.name: Capability and Authority
topics.purpose: Define capability existence and authority to use that capability as separate canonical questions, preventing policy, payload, Topic or ownership data from creating functionality that is not explicitly defined.

semantics.authority_question: Is this actor/context permitted to invoke/use the existing capability?
semantics.rule: Authority can narrow or deny use of an existing capability but cannot create a missing capability.
semantics.payload_rule: Payload/model/tool/backend output cannot grant authority or create capability.
semantics.ownership_rule: Semantic ownership does not automatically grant runtime authority.
semantics.topic_rule: Topic membership/composition does not create capability or authority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant meaning is explicit structured canonical data and is not reconstructed by hidden heuristics.

hard_gates.condition: authority declaration creates capability absent from canonical semantics
capability existence is treated as permission to execute
ownership is treated as runtime authority without explicit authority semantics
Topic membership or composition creates capability or authority

references.purpose: Authority is a distinct structural dimension.
Undefined capabilities do not exist and authority is not data.
